method.control: Full tuck, no braking; benchmark-only driver regulates velocity before and after each unchanged 120 Hz production-solver tick while retaining support, pose and collision queries
method.limitations: Surveyed geometry and speed-controlled probes are automated bounded evidence only. They do not establish ordinary handling, dynamic skiability, rendered quality, frame performance, human/controller acceptance, alternate-path coverage or other seeds.
method.obstacles: Production tree and mineral swept rider contract
method.probe: Three matched bounded speed-controlled route probes per face; retained route follower supplies steering only
method.rejoin_scope: Reachable graph nodes with multiple accepted incoming edges; not independently skied branches
method.stop_condition: Clean stop after exactly 1,800 simulation ticks; no base/finish completion is sought
method.survey: Retained height-ordered graph, 6 x 12 m; one 3 x 6 m refinement if needed
